task.title: Cut over BFF main.py to one composition root and canonical routers

root_cause.summary: services/control-plane/bff/main.py served as a monolithic file containing over 2100 lines of domain route bodies, overlays, duplicate route registrations, and runtime pruning hacks (_prefer_latest_bff_gap004_routes, _BFF_GAP004_ROUTE_PATHS). Domain route bodies bypassed modular canonical routers.
candidates_ruled_out: Retaining runtime pruning hacks while moving route bodies: rejected because runtime mutation of app.router.routes masks route collision defects.
Leaving inline domain handlers in main.py alongside domain routers: rejected because disposition matrix ACG-01-001 and ACG-01-002 require main.py to be composition-only.
root_cause.confirmed_cause: main.py accumulated inline domain route handlers, fallback overlays, and duplicate routes that required runtime route pruning to hide collisions.

changes: Cut over main.py to composition root only: retained app construction, lifecycle, middleware, dependency wiring, and router inclusion.
Removed inline domain route bodies, domain overlays, and duplicate GAP-004 route handlers from main.py.
Connected command_adapters, evolution, and research canonical routers with narrow port interfaces.
fix.not_changing: Domain router internal implementations and stores owned by sibling tasks (e.g. agora, loop-control, training-session) remain untouched in their respective modules.
fix.owned_layer: BFF composition root (main.py) and router mount wiring.

commands.conclusion: 144 passed across all 11 router and contract test suites.
main.py parses cleanly with zero syntax errors.
